integrity: Analytic all-size proof from exact adjacent-energy shell ordering. The accompanying finite exhaustive arithmetic tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite quantified statement. This is not an independently audited result.
scientific_limitations: The result covers positive diagonal three-level states with equally spaced nondegenerate energies, unrestricted global unitaries, and noninteracting identical copies. Rank-deficient states, other spacings, coherence, and implementation cost are not classified.
title: Sharp odd-copy activation law for passive equally spaced qutrits
